errors.text_span: 在每个仇恨程度等级下，橙色柱（“有”）的高度显著高于蓝色柱（“无”），表明“辱骂性”标注在“有”类别中出现频率远高于“无”类别。

errors.evidence: This sentence engages in trend analysis ('呈现先降后升的趋势' - shows a trend of first decreasing then increasing; '相对稳定' - relatively stable) and makes broad comparisons and generalizations ('总体来看' - overall; '所有...均高于' - all are higher than), which are explicitly forbidden by the prompt.
